title: MMSearch-Plus: Benchmarking Provenance-Aware Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents
authors_zh: Xijia Tao, Yihua Teng, Xinxing Su, Xinyu Fu, Jihao Wu, Chaofan Tao, Ziru Liu, Haoli Bai, Rui Liu, Lingpeng Kong
paper_type_zh: 多模态网页搜索智能体基准与数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究多模态浏览智能体、动态搜索环境、答案级judge、轨迹发布边界与污染审计的读者
one_line: MMSearch-Plus releases 311 image-grounded QA rows and evaluates agents over SerpAPI/Gemini search with answer-level GPT-4o judgment, but does not release the agent framework, SoM boxes, complete trajectories, or replay snapshots.
MMSearch-Plus发布单一train split中的311条图像问答与来源引用，并以SerpAPI/Gemini动态搜索和GPT-4o答案judge评测智能体；完整轨迹、框架、evaluator与SoM均未发布。
why: It makes weak visual cues, region-level crop/search decisions, noisy live-web retrieval, and provenance checking part of the agent evaluation contract while showing why a public question/image table alone is insufficient for trajectory reuse, verifier audit, or deterministic comparison.
inclusion_reason: MMSearch-Plus exposes a concrete image-grounded QA benchmark and defines a long-horizon multimodal search environment in which state, crop/search actions, dynamic observations, and answer-level judgment interact; its missing framework, trajectories, SoM boxes, and replay artifacts are essential audit boundaries for environment-and-agent-trajectory research.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The primary sources are arXiv:2508.21475v3, the official ICLR 2026 Poster record, the official project, the repository inspected at commit fd8137d43677f88c1ed8c8c75b2a22587049950c, and the Hugging Face dataset inspected at revision 161a60d469b67cd14a0621ae2ab66d902df02df9. The paper entry remains dated 2025 even though the verified venue is ICLR 2026.

MMSearch-Plus targets multimodal questions for which the supplied image is a clue rather than a complete answer source. Its Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation design asks for facts outside the depicted crop, frame, or moment, requiring an agent to localize an event or entity and retrieve wider web evidence. The benchmark contains 311 tasks built from public video-platform content and open-access scholarly repositories: 441 unique images, 279 unique questions, 306 unique answers, 8 primary categories, and 43 secondary categories.

The reusable public object is one image-grounded QA row with a sequence of acceptable answers, one to five images, num_images, a video_url or arxiv_id source reference, category, difficulty, and subtask. Hugging Face exposes all 311 rows in one split named train. That storage label is not a training protocol: the paper evaluates frozen models and reports no SFT, RL, distillation, reward-model, or agent-policy training on these rows.

At evaluation time, an agent additionally creates a long state-action episode over SerpAPI search, Gemini-produced summaries, crop/zoom operations, cached results, and accumulated hypotheses. Those episodes are analyzed in the paper but are not part of the public row schema. The official GitHub revision contains only README.md and decrypt_after_load.py; its pending-release checklist still names the rollout framework, evaluator, and SoM boxes, while search caches and full successful/failed trajectories are unavailable. This distinction makes the work relevant to environment_agent_trajectory_data: it defines a dynamic interaction surface while demonstrating why a QA table alone is not a trajectory corpus. The bilingual body reaches L4 screening depth, but accepted workflow metadata correctly remains L3_summary_ready.

本卡的主要来源是arXiv:2508.21475v3、ICLR 2026 Poster官方条目、官方项目页、在提交fd8137d43677f88c1ed8c8c75b2a22587049950c上检查的仓库，以及在revision 161a60d469b67cd14a0621ae2ab66d902df02df9上检查的Hugging Face数据集。虽然已核实venue为ICLR 2026，但论文条目年份仍保留2025。

MMSearch-Plus关注一类多模态问题：给定图像只是线索，并不直接包含完整答案。其Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation设计要求寻找画面、裁剪区域或时刻之外的事实，使智能体必须先定位事件或实体，再从更广的网页证据中检索。基准从公开视频平台内容和开放获取学术资源构建311项任务，共含441张unique image、279个unique question、306个unique answer、8个primary category和43个secondary category。

可公开复用的对象是一条image-grounded QA记录，包括acceptable answer序列、一至五张图像、num_images、video_url或arxiv_id来源引用、category、difficulty和subtask。Hugging Face把全部311条记录放在一个名为train的split中。这个存储标签不代表训练协议：论文评测冻结模型，没有报告使用这些记录进行SFT、RL、distillation、reward-model训练或agent-policy training。

评测时，智能体还会围绕SerpAPI搜索、Gemini生成的摘要、crop/zoom操作、缓存结果和累积hypothesis生成长state-action episode。论文分析了这些episode，但它们不在公开记录schema中。已检查的官方GitHub revision只有README.md与decrypt_after_load.py；其待发布清单仍列有rollout framework、evaluator和SoM box，而search cache及完整成功/失败轨迹不可用。这一边界使该工作属于environment_agent_trajectory_data：它定义了动态交互表面，同时表明QA表并不等同于轨迹语料。双语正文达到L4筛选深度，但accepted workflow metadata仍正确保持L3_summary_ready。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is a provenance-aware multimodal search benchmark built by Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation: annotators select a video keyframe or scholarly figure/table, then ask about information beyond the visible region or moment. Candidate questions are tested on at least two closed MLLMs; no-search-solvable items are removed or obfuscated, critical regions may be blurred or masked, and items that remain trivial are discarded. Exact model pairs, prompts, outputs, rejection counts, and per-item decisions are not released.

The public data object is the 311-row QA/image/source-reference set. The paper-defined evaluation object is broader: an initial question and images feed a threaded agent state containing text/image searches, URLs and titles, Gemini webpage or related-image summaries, crops, hypotheses, and a final answer. Text search, image search, indexed zoom/crop through human-authored SoM boxes, and final answer form the action surface. The SoM boxes were human-curated and verified for the experiments, but the repository still lists them in its pending-release checklist.

The primary feedback attaches at the answer level. GPT-4o compares the final prediction with acceptable answer variants and returns binary correctness; lightweight rule matching is mentioned as optional but its implementation is not released or specified. This makes the accepted verification contract mixed, while the material published result remains LLM judgment. The judge does not verify whether retrieved pages support the answer, whether citations are correct, whether Gemini summaries preserve evidence, or whether each search/crop transition has valid provenance. State-action structure exists in evaluation episodes, but no step-level provenance labels or training reward are released.

Relative to MMSearch, BrowseComp-VL, and MM-BrowseComp, the concrete change is to make weak visual localization and retrieval beyond the depicted time/space jointly necessary, while preserving source references in the public rows. Live search, visual QA, LLM answer judging, cropping, and Set-of-Mark are not new separately. The direction signal is their coupling to a provenance-oriented task object—and the visible gap between that task object and the unreleased dynamic episode needed to audit the claimed provenance.

核心贡献是一套通过Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation构建的provenance-aware多模态搜索基准：标注者选择视频keyframe或学术论文的figure/table，再询问可见区域或时刻之外的信息。候选问题会交给至少两个闭源MLLM测试；无需搜索即可回答的条目被移除或混淆，关键区域可被blur或mask，仍然过于简单的条目会被丢弃。确切模型组合、prompt、output、拒绝数量和逐条决策均未发布。

公开data object是311条QA/image/source-reference记录。论文定义的评测对象更宽：初始问题与图像进入threaded agent state，其中包含text/image search、URL与title、Gemini生成的webpage或related-image summary、crop、hypothesis及final answer。动作表面由text search、image search、基于人工SoM box的indexed zoom/crop和final answer组成。实验中的SoM box由人工整理与核验，但仓库仍把其列入待发布清单。

主要反馈附着在answer level。GPT-4o把最终预测与acceptable answer variant比较并给出二值correctness；论文提及可选lightweight rule matching，但实现未发布也未详细说明。因此accepted verification contract是mixed，而实际公开结果仍主要依赖LLM judgment。judge不会验证检索页面是否支持答案、citation是否正确、Gemini summary是否保留证据，也不会验证每次search/crop transition是否具有有效provenance。state-action结构存在于评测episode中，但没有发布step-level provenance label或training reward。

相对MMSearch、BrowseComp-VL和MM-BrowseComp，具体变化是让弱视觉定位与超出画面时空范围的检索同时成为必要条件，并在公开记录中保留来源引用。live search、visual QA、LLM answer judge、cropping和Set-of-Mark本身都不是新组件。其方向信号来自这些组件与provenance-oriented任务对象的耦合，以及该任务对象与审计provenance所需、但未发布的动态episode之间的明显缺口。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and construction. Annotators browse public consumer videos and open-access arXiv papers for at least 10 and at most 20 minutes per task, select keyframes or figure/table screenshots, and write Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation questions with acceptable short answers. LLM assistance proposes search keywords; humans curate sources, difficulty, subtask, and SoM boxes. Faces and license plates are reportedly masked and minors/private spaces excluded when feasible. At least two closed MLLMs test no-search solvability; answerable items are removed or made harder through masking/obfuscation. The final set has 311 tasks, including 94 easy and 217 hard; the 239-task MMSearch-Plus-lite subset removes every item solved without search by any tested model.

Released output. One Hugging Face train split stores question, answer variants, num_images, arxiv_id, video_url, category, difficulty, subtask, and img_1 through img_5. Text fields question, answer, video_url, and arxiv_id are XOR-decrypted by a public canary helper; current images are not encrypted. The release preserves a source reference, not the source snapshot, annotation/edit log, SoM boxes, or rights manifest.

Evaluation rollout. A frozen MLLM receives the question and images, then alternates among text search, image search, indexed zoom/crop, and final answer. SerpAPI supplies ranked text/image results and thumbnails; Gemini produces webpage and related-image summaries; a threaded state retains calls, crops, summaries, URLs/titles, and hypotheses. The paper caps combined search rounds/tool calls at 20, or 10 for Qwen full rollout. Text-search rounds may issue three to five queries. Search responses, cache snapshots, prompts, seeds, locale, browser state, and complete action-observation logs are not public.

Feedback and use. GPT-4o judges final-answer agreement with acceptable variants; optional rule matching is mentioned but not released. The terminal event is a final answer or budget exhaustion, while benchmark success is answer correctness—not citation completeness, provenance fidelity, or verified step transitions. No optimizer or post-training scaffold is used; the paper evaluates o3, GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Qwen-2.5-VL-72B-Instruct.

Reproducibility boundary. A faithful replay would need the pinned HF rows and source captures, released SoM boxes, rollout/evaluation code, SerpAPI responses, Gemini summaries, cache, model/API versions, prompts, seeds, query date/locale, browser/runtime lock, budgets, judge logs, and success/failure trajectories. The audited GitHub revision provides only README and a decryption helper, and Hugging Face state.json references two obsolete shard names while the current release contains five Arrow shards. Pin the verified data revision rather than treating state.json as a complete manifest.

输入与构造。 标注者针对每项任务浏览公开视频和开放获取arXiv论文至少10分钟、至多20分钟，选择keyframe或figure/table截图，并撰写Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation问题与acceptable short answer。LLM辅助生成搜索关键词；人类负责筛选来源、difficulty、subtask和SoM box。作者称在可行时遮蔽人脸和车牌，并排除未成年人或私人空间。至少两个闭源MLLM测试候选题能否无需搜索作答；可直接回答的条目被移除，或通过mask/obfuscation增加难度。最终集合含311项任务，其中94项easy、217项hard；239项MMSearch-Plus-lite移除了所有被任一测试模型无需搜索解决的条目。

公开输出。 Hugging Face的单一train split存储question、answer variant、num_images、arxiv_id、video_url、category、difficulty、subtask及img_1至img_5。文本字段question、answer、video_url和arxiv_id通过公开canary helper进行XOR解密；当前图像未加密。发布保留来源引用，但不含source snapshot、annotation/edit log、SoM box或rights manifest。

评测rollout。 冻结MLLM接收问题与图像，再在text search、image search、indexed zoom/crop和final answer之间交替。SerpAPI提供排序后的text/image result与thumbnail；Gemini生成webpage和related-image summary；threaded state保留call、crop、summary、URL/title与hypothesis。论文把combined search round/tool call上限设为20，Qwen full rollout则为10；每轮text search可发出三至五个query。search response、cache snapshot、prompt、seed、locale、browser state和完整action-observation log均未公开。

反馈与用途。 GPT-4o判断final answer与acceptable variant是否一致；可选rule matching被提及但未发布。终止事件是产生final answer或耗尽预算，而benchmark success只表示答案正确，不代表citation完整、provenance忠实或step transition经过验证。论文没有使用optimizer或post-training scaffold，只评测o3、GPT-5、Gemini-2.5-Pro和Qwen-2.5-VL-72B-Instruct。

复现边界。 忠实replay需要固定HF记录与source capture，并获得SoM box、rollout/evaluation code、SerpAPI response、Gemini summary、cache、模型/API版本、prompt、seed、查询日期/locale、browser/runtime lock、预算、judge log及成败轨迹。已审计GitHub revision只有README和decryption helper；Hugging Face的state.json仍引用两个过期shard名称，而当前发布实际含五个Arrow shard。复用时应固定已核实data revision，不能把state.json视为完整manifest。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All performance numbers are author-reported and were not independently reproduced with a pinned search environment. On the 311-task benchmark, o3 scores 15.1% without search, 36.0% with full rollout, and 37.6% with full rollout plus SoM. Gemini rises from 23.8% to 27.7% with SoM. Qwen shows a negative result: 13.5% under the image-search setting falls to 6.1% under full rollout. These results show that retrieval and localization interfaces change outcomes; they do not establish dataset quality, provenance fidelity, or trajectory reusability (Paper Table 1).

The paper isolates 23 easy items that o3 answered correctly with image-only input but incorrectly under full rollout. Among 10 sampled trajectories, 9 never invoked image search. Qwen produced 421 invalid image-search calls across 45 of 311 tasks. These observations locate tool-policy and action-format failures, but the sampled and aggregate reports do not substitute for release of every action, observation, error, retry, and final judge record (Sections 4 and 5.1).

For Gemini full rollout errors, the authors label 51.1% as “no relevant information found” and 11.5% as hallucination. The taxonomy assigns one dominant label per error, so it does not measure overlapping causes such as bad query choice, search drift, lossy Gemini summaries, wrong visual localization, and answer-judge error. The complete labeled episode corpus is unavailable (Section 5.2, Figure 6).

GPT-4o answer judgments reportedly agree completely with manual inspection, and initial GPT-4o/Gemini comparisons are described as consistent. However, the validation sample size, raw labels, disagreements, judge prompt/settings, and optional rule-based implementation are not disclosed. This supports use of the reported accuracy metric under the authors' setup, not a claim that the judge is calibrated for every acceptable answer or that it verifies step provenance.

以下性能数字均为作者报告，尚未在固定搜索环境中独立复现。在311项任务上，o3无需搜索时为15.1%，full rollout为36.0%，full rollout加SoM为37.6%。Gemini加入SoM后从23.8%升至27.7%。Qwen出现负结果：image-search设置为13.5%，full rollout反而降至6.1%。这些结果说明检索与定位接口会改变结果，但不能证明数据质量、provenance fidelity或轨迹可复用性（论文表1）。

论文分析了23项easy任务：o3在image-only输入下答对，却在full rollout下答错。抽样的10条轨迹中，有9条从未调用image search。Qwen在311项任务中的45项上产生421次无效image-search call。这些观察定位了tool-policy和action-format故障，但抽样与聚合报告不能替代对每次action、observation、error、retry和final judge record的完整发布（第4节与第5.1节）。

对Gemini full rollout错误，作者把51.1%标为“未找到相关信息”，11.5%标为hallucination。该taxonomy为每个错误只分配一个dominant label，因此无法测量bad query、search drift、Gemini summary信息损失、错误视觉定位与answer-judge错误等原因的重叠。完整带标签episode语料并未发布（第5.2节、图6）。

作者报告GPT-4o答案判断与人工检查完全一致，并称初步GPT-4o/Gemini判断一致。然而，validation sample size、raw label、disagreement、judge prompt/setting及可选rule-based实现均未披露。该证据支持在作者设置下使用报告accuracy metric，但不能说明judge对所有acceptable answer均已校准，也不能说明它验证了step provenance。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior multimodal browsing benchmarks such as MMSearch, BrowseComp-VL, and MM-BrowseComp already combine images, questions, retrieval, or web-agent evaluation. MMSearch-Plus changes the task object through Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation: the image anchors an event or entity, while the requested answer lies beyond the displayed space or time. Annotators preserve a video or arXiv source reference and adversarially remove questions that closed MLLMs can answer without retrieval.

The second concrete change is the evaluated interface. The agent can alternate text search, image search, and human-authored SoM-indexed crop/search while carrying a threaded hypothesis state over SerpAPI results and Gemini summaries. This makes failures in visual localization, query policy, retrieval, synthesis, and stopping separately discussable. However, the public release serializes only QA/image/source-reference rows; the dynamic state and transitions that motivate the analysis are not released.

The feedback design remains answer-centric. Acceptable variants and GPT-4o semantic judgment make open-form scoring practical, but they do not produce citation verification or step-level provenance supervision. The paper's state_action_level evaluation surface reflects the agent's interaction process, not a released labeled state-action dataset. SoM gains likewise measure privileged human localization and do not establish automatic detection capability.

What is not new is visual QA, live search, LLM-generated summaries, LLM-as-a-judge, crop/zoom tools, reversible obfuscation, or Set-of-Mark individually. The 311-task scale and model score changes are evaluation breadth, not independent evidence of record correctness. Before reuse, verify source snapshots and rights, annotation/filter lineage, SoM release, evaluator calibration, success/failure episode retention, search/cache versions, replay locks, split policy, and formal contamination controls.

MMSearch、BrowseComp-VL和MM-BrowseComp等既有多模态浏览benchmark已经组合图像、问题、检索或web-agent evaluation。MMSearch-Plus通过Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation改变task object：图像用于锚定事件或实体，而问题所求答案位于画面之外的空间或时间。标注者保留video或arXiv来源引用，并通过对闭源MLLM的adversarial filtering移除无需检索即可回答的问题。

第二项具体变化是被评测接口。智能体可在text search、image search和基于人工SoM index的crop/search之间切换，同时在SerpAPI result与Gemini summary之上维护threaded hypothesis state。因此，视觉定位、query policy、retrieval、synthesis和stopping的故障可以分别讨论。不过，公开发布只序列化QA/image/source-reference记录；支撑这些分析的动态state与transition并未发布。

反馈设计仍以答案为中心。acceptable variant与GPT-4o语义判断便于开放形式评分，但不会产生citation verification或step-level provenance supervision。论文中的state_action_level评测表面来自智能体交互过程，并不代表已发布带标签state-action dataset。SoM收益同样衡量特权人工定位，不能说明具备automatic detection能力。

visual QA、live search、LLM生成summary、LLM-as-a-judge、crop/zoom tool、可逆混淆或Set-of-Mark本身都不是新组件。311项任务规模与模型分数变化体现评测广度，并非逐记录正确性的独立证据。复用前仍需核实source snapshot与权利、annotation/filter lineage、SoM发布、evaluator校准、成败episode保留、search/cache版本、replay lock、split政策和正式contamination control。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Public-object boundary: Hugging Face releases 311 QA/image/source-reference rows in one train split and a decryption helper. It does not release the complete successful or failed search episodes, framework, evaluator, SoM boxes, search results, Gemini summaries, caches, judge logs, or deterministic replay manifest. The GitHub README still places framework code, evaluation script, and SoM annotations in its pending-release checklist.
  • Answer judge: GPT-4o scores semantic agreement with acceptable answers, not citation support or step provenance. Reported manual agreement lacks a disclosed sample size and raw labels; judge prompt, API settings, calibration by answer/category, and optional rule implementation are unavailable. Alternative valid answers can be rejected and unsupported answers accepted.
  • Dynamic substrate: Live SerpAPI rankings, thumbnails, pages, regional availability, query locale, dead links, and near-duplicates change. Gemini-generated page/image summaries can omit or distort evidence before the evaluated model sees it. Without frozen responses and caches, later runs need not receive the same observations.
  • Replay and release drift: Model/API versions, prompts, seeds, browser/runtime, dates, locale, reset semantics, retries, and source snapshots are incompletely pinned. Current Hugging Face data uses five Arrow shards while state.json references two obsolete names, so consumers must pin the audited revision and inspect actual files.
  • Split and contamination: The sole public split is named train, but no independent dev/test or hidden holdout exists and author use is evaluation-only. New/rare event selection, no-search filtering, Google image-search resistance, masking, and public XOR encryption reduce shortcuts but do not establish pretraining-overlap measurement, cross-benchmark deduplication, or future contamination control. The public canary and decryptor make encryption a speed bump.
  • Lineage, privacy, and rights: Rows retain video_url or arxiv_id, but lack source snapshots, annotator/edit/filter/redaction logs, SoM mapping, and item-level rights classification. The paper and HF card declare CC BY 4.0, while the GitHub tree has no license file and video frames or arXiv figures/tables retain heterogeneous third-party rights. Masking, exclusion, and takedown claims lack a public record-level audit.
  • Experimental attribution: SoM uses human-curated boxes, Qwen receives a lower 10-call cap, and the error taxonomy assigns one dominant cause. Reported score differences therefore mix model capability, privileged localization, tool policy, search/summarizer state, budget, and judge behavior; benchmark performance alone cannot certify the data object.

• 公开对象边界： Hugging Face在一个train split中发布311条QA/image/source-reference记录与decryption helper，但未发布完整成功或失败search episode、framework、evaluator、SoM box、search result、Gemini summary、cache、judge log或确定性replay manifest。GitHub README仍把framework code、evaluation script和SoM annotation列在待发布清单中。
  • 答案judge： GPT-4o评分的是与acceptable answer的语义一致性，而非citation support或step provenance。作者报告的人工一致性没有披露sample size与raw label；judge prompt、API setting、按答案/类别校准结果及可选rule实现均不可用。其他有效答案可能被拒绝，不受证据支持的答案也可能被接受。
  • 动态substrate： 实时SerpAPI排名、thumbnail、页面、区域可用性、query locale、失效链接与near-duplicate都会变化。Gemini生成的page/image summary可能在被测模型看到之前遗漏或扭曲证据。没有冻结response与cache，后续运行不一定接收相同observation。
  • 回放与发布漂移： 模型/API版本、prompt、seed、browser/runtime、日期、locale、reset语义、retry和source snapshot都未完整固定。当前Hugging Face数据实际使用五个Arrow shard，而state.json引用两个过期名称；使用者必须固定已审计revision并检查实际文件。
  • 划分与污染： 唯一公开split名为train，但没有独立dev/test或隐藏holdout，作者用途也仅限evaluation。选择新近/罕见事件、no-search过滤、抵抗Google image search、mask和公开XOR加密可减少shortcut，却不能证明完成pretraining-overlap测量、跨benchmark去重或未来污染控制。公开canary与decryptor使加密只是一道速度障碍。
  • Lineage、隐私与权利： 记录保留video_url或arxiv_id，但缺少source snapshot、annotator/edit/filter/redaction log、SoM mapping和逐条rights classification。论文与HF card声明CC BY 4.0，但GitHub tree没有license file，视频帧或arXiv figure/table仍具有异质第三方权利。mask、排除和takedown主张也缺少公开逐记录审计。
  • 实验归因： SoM使用人工box，Qwen采用更低的10-call上限，error taxonomy为每项错误只分配一个dominant cause。报告分数差异因而混合模型能力、特权定位、tool policy、search/summarizer state、预算和judge行为；benchmark performance本身不能认证data object。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, MMSearch-Plus is useful first as an evaluation boundary case. The public row supplies question, acceptable answers, images, category/difficulty/subtask, and a source reference; it does not supply the interaction object that the paper analyzes. A reusable derived episode should additionally pin source captures, queries, SerpAPI results, Gemini summaries, crops/SoM indices, hypotheses, model actions, invalid calls, timestamps, budgets, stopping reason, final answer, citations, judge prompt/output, and all success/failure/retry states.

The benchmark supports controlled studies of where multimodal search fails. With fixed items, APIs, caches, budget, and judge, researchers can compare no search, text search, image search, full rollout, and SoM; audit skipped image search and invalid-call loops; and separate localization, retrieval, summarization, synthesis, and stopping errors. Human SoM boxes must be reported as privileged supervision rather than silently merged with automatic agent capability.

The answer contract supports judge audits, not process certification. Researchers can construct human-labeled alternative-answer and citation sets, measure GPT-4o false positives/negatives, compare the optional rule baseline once released, and test whether answer accuracy changes when search evidence is held constant. Provenance-aware evaluation should score citation/evidence support separately because the published judge does not.

The supported reuse class is evaluation and audit only, matching training_use: evaluation. The HF split name train must not be interpreted as permission or evidence for training. Direct SFT, RL, preference, reward-model, or agent-policy reuse is blocked pending a complete trajectory release, explicit partition/refresh policy, contamination audit, frozen replay package, evaluator/SoM release, and item-level third-party rights review. Scores motivate these checks; they do not prove data quality.

对environment_agent_trajectory_data而言，MMSearch-Plus首先是一个评测边界案例。公开记录提供question、acceptable answer、image、category/difficulty/subtask和来源引用，却没有提供论文所分析的interaction object。可复用派生episode还应固定source capture、query、SerpAPI result、Gemini summary、crop/SoM index、hypothesis、model action、invalid call、timestamp、budget、停止原因、final answer、citation、judge prompt/output及全部success/failure/retry state。

该benchmark适合受控研究多模态搜索在何处失败。固定item、API、cache、budget和judge后，可以比较no search、text search、image search、full rollout和SoM，审计跳过image search与invalid-call loop，并分离localization、retrieval、summarization、synthesis和stopping错误。人工SoM box必须报告为privileged supervision，不能悄然并入自动agent capability。

答案契约可支持judge audit，但不能认证过程。研究者可以构建带人类标签的alternate-answer与citation集合，测量GPT-4o false positive/negative，在可选rule baseline发布后进行比较，并测试固定search evidence时answer accuracy是否变化。provenance-aware evaluation还应单独评分citation/evidence support，因为公开judge没有覆盖它们。

有证据支持的复用等级是仅限评测与审计，与training_use: evaluation一致。HF split名为train，不能据此推断训练许可或作者训练用途。直接用于SFT、RL、偏好学习、reward-model或agent-policy training仍受阻，直到完整轨迹发布、明确partition/refresh政策、contamination audit、冻结replay package、evaluator/SoM发布和逐条第三方权利审查完成。分数可以推动这些检查，但不能证明数据质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Sections 2.1-2.5 to separate Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation construction, the 311 released QA/image/source-reference rows, and the paper-defined but unreleased search episode.
  • Keep the release counts distinct: 311 rows in one HF split named train, 441 unique images, 279 unique questions, 306 unique answers, 94 easy and 217 hard tasks, and a derived 239-task lite subset.
  • Treat GPT-4o as an answer-level judge: it checks acceptable-answer agreement but not citation support, Gemini-summary fidelity, search actions, or step provenance.
  • Read Table 1 and Sections 4-5 for both gains and regressions: o3 improves with rollout/SoM, while Qwen falls under full rollout and emits 421 invalid image-search calls across 45 tasks.
  • Separate published data from runtime artifacts: SerpAPI results, Gemini summaries, cache, SoM boxes, framework/evaluator code, and complete successful/failed trajectories are not released at the audited revisions.
  • Before reuse, pin the HF revision rather than stale state.json, then audit dynamic-search drift, judge calibration, public-canary contamination, split policy, source/redaction lineage, and third-party rights.

• 先读第2.1-2.5节，以区分Spatial-Temporal Extrapolation构造、公开的311条QA/image/source-reference记录，以及论文定义但未发布的search episode。
  • 区分各项规模：HF单一train split含311条记录、441张unique image、279个unique question、306个unique answer、94项easy与217项hard任务，另有派生的239项lite子集。
  • 把GPT-4o视为answer-level judge：它检查acceptable-answer一致性，但不检查citation support、Gemini-summary fidelity、search action或step provenance。
  • 阅读表1和第4-5节时同时看提升与退化：o3通过rollout/SoM提升，而Qwen在full rollout下降，并在45项任务中产生421次无效image-search call。
  • 区分公开数据与runtime artifact：SerpAPI result、Gemini summary、cache、SoM box、framework/evaluator code及完整成功/失败轨迹在已审计revision均未发布。
  • 复用前应固定HF revision而非过期state.json，并审计dynamic-search drift、judge calibration、public-canary contamination、split政策、source/redaction lineage和第三方权利。

value.html: One public benchmark row contains an image-grounded question, a sequence of acceptable short answers, one to five images, num_images, a source reference (video_url or arxiv_id), primary category, difficulty label, and subtask. An evaluation run additionally creates an unreleased dynamic episode of search/zoom actions, retrieved results, summaries, hypotheses, and a final answer.

Human annotators select keyframes from publicly accessible video platforms or screenshots of figures/tables from open-access arXiv papers. Search keywords are produced with LLM assistance plus manual curation.

Initial question and images plus a threaded, evaluation-time state containing tool calls, cropped views, SerpAPI results, Gemini-produced webpage/image summaries, URLs/titles, and accumulated hypotheses. The public release does not contain this state.
Ranked SerpAPI text/image candidates, thumbnails, page summaries, related-image summaries, and cropped sub-images. Responses and cache snapshots are not included in the released dataset.
A short natural-language answer, optionally citing retrieved webpage IDs in the agent prompt; the benchmark stores a list of acceptable answer variants.
Final predicted answer for scoring. The public artifact is the benchmark row, not a browser replay, evidence bundle, or recorded agent trajectory.
Evaluation-time MLLMs (o3, GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Qwen-2.5-VL-72B-Instruct in the paper) generate tool-use episodes. Complete episodes are analyzed in the paper but are not released as a corpus.

Text search, image search, indexed zoom/crop through human-authored SoM boxes, and final answer. Text-search rounds may issue three to five queries; the paper caps combined search rounds/tool calls at 20, or 10 for Qwen in full-rollout experiments.

Live/open-web search through SerpAPI with text search, image search, Gemini result summarization, cached image-search returns, and optional SoM-indexed crop/search actions. The paper's framework implementation and frozen search snapshots are not released.

A model-agnostic threaded agent loop over SerpAPI text/image search, Gemini page/result summaries, caching, SoM-indexed zoom/crop, and a structured final answer prompt. The implementation and exact runtime lock are unavailable.
Qualitative adversarial filtering is described, but no score threshold, agreement rule, rejection counts, or item-level decision manifest is released.

Annotators test candidates on at least two closed MLLMs, remove or obfuscate questions answerable without retrieval, blur/mask critical visual regions where needed, and discard items that remain trivial. Future refreshes are promised when model knowledge makes items easier.
Evaluation permits at most 20 combined search rounds/tool calls; Qwen full rollout is capped at 10 after pilots. Human annotators browse for at least 10 and at most 20 minutes per task.
No optimizer or post-training scaffold is used. This work evaluates frozen models in a tool environment.

Public consumer video-platform content and open-access arXiv papers across geography, sports, academic research, film/TV, technology, games, vlogs, and music. Counts are disclosed by topical category, not by source platform, license class, language, region, or collection date.

HF exposes one split named train containing all 311 examples. The paper also labels 94 easy and 217 hard tasks and derives a 239-task MMSearch-Plus-lite subset by removing every item solved without search by any tested model. No independent dev/test or hidden holdout is released; the train label must not be mistaken for evidence that authors trained on the benchmark.

Authors state the benchmark is constructed from source events rather than remixed text-only corpora and compare with MMSearch, BrowseComp-VL, and MM-BrowseComp. No item-level overlap report or public deduplication manifest against those benchmarks or web indexes is released.

Authors seek new/rare events, require screenshots not directly retrievable by Google image search, test no-search solvability on at least two closed MLLMs, perturb or discard easy items, and publish encrypted text fields. These checks reduce shortcuts but do not establish formal pretraining overlap, cross-benchmark deduplication, or future-model contamination control.

The paper analyzes correct and incorrect evaluation episodes and prints selected qualitative cases, but no full episode corpus is released. Therefore the public artifact does not preserve either all successful rollouts or all failed attempts, nor item-level exclusion reasons from benchmark construction.

Deterministic replay is blocked by live SerpAPI results, unreleased search-result caches and Gemini summaries, absent framework/evaluation code, missing SoM boxes, missing action-observation histories and seeds, and incompletely pinned model/API and browser/runtime versions.

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: GPT-4o judges short answers against acceptable variants, so semantic false positives/negatives remain possible; “complete agreement” is reported for manual inspection without a disclosed validation-set size or judge-log release.
Final answer accuracy does not verify citation correctness, provenance quality, or whether intermediate summaries faithfully represent source pages.
Gemini-generated webpage and related-image summaries can omit or distort key evidence before the evaluated agent sees it.
Dynamic web results, near-duplicate images, dead pages, regional ranking, and search-engine drift can change task difficulty and final scores.
SoM uses human-curated boxes and therefore measures reasoning with privileged localization; its gain does not establish performance with automatic detection.
Tool-policy errors can skip necessary image search even when image-only retrieval succeeds.
Qwen produced 421 invalid image-search calls across 45 of 311 tasks.
For Gemini full rollout, 51.1% of errors were labeled no-relevant-information-found and 11.5% hallucination.
Models can lock onto visually similar but wrong events or summarize a relevant page without the needed fact.
Internal model knowledge changes over time, making the easy/hard boundary and no-search resistance unstable.
The public canary-based XOR decryption is not a durable contamination barrier once the dataset is public.
HF state.json references two obsolete shard names while the current release has five Arrow shards.
Reported scores are author results; no independent reproduction with a pinned end-to-end environment was verified.

value.html: Authors report masking faces and license plates, excluding minors/private spaces when feasible, retaining source attribution, and offering takedown. Public redaction logs, annotator/subject consent records, and a verified takedown URL are unavailable.

The arXiv manuscript and current HF dataset card declare CC BY 4.0. The pinned official GitHub tree has no license file. Video keyframes and arXiv figures/tables are third-party source material with heterogeneous rights; the paper says it follows platform terms/licenses and preserves attribution, but no item-level rights manifest reconciles those sources with the dataset-level license.

Rows preserve either video_url or arxiv_id, category, difficulty, subtask, images, question, and acceptable answers. Raw source snapshots, annotator IDs, edit/filter decisions, redaction logs, SoM boxes, search evidence, and judge records are not linked in a record-level lineage manifest.
